# cTrader — How to import trades from cTrader into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/9546392-ctrader-how-to-import-trades-from-ctrader-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

Easily import your trades from cTrader into TradeZella by using the file upload method. Follow this simple step mentioned below.

💡 Pro Tip: Want to effortlessly import your trades into TradeZella?​Good news! TradeZella fully supports cTrader sync. Just head over to the Broker Sync page and follow the easy steps to connect your cTrader account and have your trade imported automatically into TradeZella. Happy trading!



## Exporting trade data from cTrader into a file

- Open your cTrader desktop application. Once open, locate the History tab in the bottom section of cTrader.

Open your cTrader desktop application. Once open, locate the History tab in the bottom section of cTrader.

- Right-click on the columns in the History tab and ensure all available columns are selected for export.

Right-click on the columns in the History tab and ensure all available columns are selected for export.

- Navigate to the Positions tab, right-click on the columns, and make sure all columns are selected here as well.

Navigate to the Positions tab, right-click on the columns, and make sure all columns are selected here as well.

- Return to the History tab, select "ALL HISTORY" or choose a custom date range for the trades you want to export. Leave "All Directions (Default)" selected.

Return to the History tab, select "ALL HISTORY" or choose a custom date range for the trades you want to export. Leave "All Directions (Default)" selected.

- Click on the green "Statement" button to download the file. Ensure the report is exported as an HTML file.

Click on the green "Statement" button to download the file. Ensure the report is exported as an HTML file.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select cTrader as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select cTrader as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



## Common Errors

- Language and Format: Ensure that the exported file is in English and in HTML format, as TradeZella expects this format for cTrader files.

Language and Format: Ensure that the exported file is in English and in HTML format, as TradeZella expects this format for cTrader files.

- Column Selection: If your file still fails to upload, ensure that you have selected all the columns in both the History and Positions tabs.

Column Selection: If your file still fails to upload, ensure that you have selected all the columns in both the History and Positions tabs.



Exporting your trades from cTrader into TradeZella is designed to be simple and efficient. By following these steps, you ensure your trading records are accurate and up-to-date, allowing you to take advantage of TradeZella's powerful features.
